report_name: Industrial Ransomware Attacks Surge 11% in Q3 2026, Dragos Reports

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: Identified as the most prolific ransomware group targeting industrial organizations in Q3 2026, responsible for 195 attacks. The group is known to operate a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) model and use phishing for initial access.

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group identified as the second most active in attacking industrial organizations in Q3 2026, after Qilin.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Used as a primary attack vector to gain initial access to industrial organizations by exploiting vulnerabilities in internet-facing devices.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Used as a primary attack vector to gain initial access through stolen or weak credentials for remote access services like VPN and RDP.

attack_patterns.name: System Information Discovery
attack_patterns.description: Used by attackers after initial access to perform reconnaissance, map the internal network, and identify critical assets.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
attack_patterns.description: Abused for lateral movement within the victim network to access high-value servers.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: Used to steal large volumes of sensitive data and upload it to attacker-controlled cloud storage as part of a double-extortion model.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The ransomware payload is deployed to encrypt files across the network, causing production disruptions.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Attackers delete volume shadow copies using commands like 'wmic.exe shadowcopy delete' to prevent easy recovery from ransomware encryption.

malware.name: Qilin
malware.description: Ransomware payload deployed by the Qilin group to encrypt files on victim networks in the industrial sector. The attacks sometimes focus on data exfiltration for extortion without encryption.

tools.name: PsExec
tools.description: A common lateral movement tool that security teams should monitor for as a sign of ransomware precursor activity.

tools.name: Cobalt Strike
tools.description: A common C2 framework that security teams should monitor for as a sign of ransomware precursor activity.

tools.name: wmic
tools.description: Used by attackers to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

identities.name: Manufacturing Sector
identities.description: The most heavily impacted industrial sector, accounting for 69% (876 incidents) of all ransomware attacks in Q3 2026.

identities.name: Engineering Firms
identities.description: A heavily affected sector, particularly firms that support Operational Technology (OT).

identities.name: Transportation Companies
identities.description: A heavily affected industrial sector targeted by ransomware attacks in Q3 2026.

infrastructure.name: Attacker-controlled cloud storage
infrastructure.description: Used by ransomware groups to exfiltrate large volumes of sensitive data for double-extortion tactics.

indicators.name: WMIC Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: WMIC Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2a9e3b1c-4d5f-4a6b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of wmic.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://industrialcyber.co/reports/dragos-finds-industrial-ransomware-attacks-rose-11-in-q3-2026-with-manufacturing-accounting-for-69-of-victims/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-23
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the command 'wmic.exe shadowcopy delete', which is used by attackers to delete volume shadow copies to prevent easy recovery.
